goal: Create the scripts/youtube_trends package with discover.py, which fetches YouTube most-popular videos and writes them as JSON lines, plus its unittest file. Standard library only.
requirements: scripts/youtube_trends/__init__.py is empty. discover.py sets API_URL = "https://www.googleapis.com/youtube/v3/videos".
build_url(api_key, region, max_results) clamps max_results to 1..50 and returns API_URL + "?" + urlencode of part, chart, regionCode, maxResults and key.
parse_items(payload) maps each payload.get("items", []) entry to video_id, title, channel_id, channel_title, published_at, category_id, tags, views and likes; missing values never raise.
fetch_most_popular(api_key, region, max_results=50, opener=None) calls opener(url, timeout=20). HTTPError becomes RuntimeError with status and first 200 body chars; key shown as ***.
write_jsonl(items, path) writes one JSON line per item, UTF-8, ensure_ascii=False. main(argv=None) -> int is described in context.
context: main(argv=None) -> int: argparse flags --region (default "US"), --max (int, default 50), --out (required). Insert the repo root, Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2], at sys.path[0]. Then key = secrets_store.get("yt-key") from router. If key is None, print "yt-key is not set" to stderr and return 2. Otherwise fetch, write the JSON lines, print "wrote N videos to <out>" and return 0. End the file with if __name__ == "__main__": raise SystemExit(main()). The unittest file imports with from scripts.youtube_trends import discover and uses a fake opener only. Do not call the live API and do not touch any existing file.
